name: strata
description: Use the Strata staging service for evidence-aware business-case work.

interface.shortDescription: Create, develop, and read Strata business cases
interface.longDescription: Elicit and create a coherent initial business case, develop its evidence-backed assumptions and scenarios, or resolve it to read exact current state, history, comparisons, and evidence lineage.
defaultPrompt: Use Strata to create a complete business case from a decision idea.
Use Strata to develop evidence-backed drivers and scenarios for a business case.
Use Strata to explain a business case from exact current state and history.
